questions.title: Snippet Activity Pick Trace
questions.description: Activities are picked greedily by earliest finish. What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
acts = [(1, 3), (2, 4), (3, 5)]
acts.sort(key=lambda a: a[1])
picked = []
last = 0
for s, e in acts:
    if s >= last:
        picked.append((s, e))
        last = e
print(len(picked))

questions.title: Snippet Fractional Knapsack Trace
questions.description: Items are (value, weight); the greedy fills by value/weight ratio, splitting the last item. What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
items = [(60, 10), (100, 20), (120, 30)]
cap = 50
items.sort(key=lambda i: i[0] / i[1], reverse=True)
total = 0.0
for v, w in items:
    if cap >= w:
        total += v; cap -= w
    else:
        total += v * cap / w
        break
print(total)
